title: Rearrange Products Table
summary: Unpivot store prices into one row per (product, store) with a non-NULL price.
inputFormat: Products(product_id, store1, store2, store3) with nullable price columns.
outputFormat: Rows product_id, store, price; NULL prices omitted.
edgeRules: NULL prices produce no output row.

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.text: authored-reference: product 0 with store1 95 and store2 NULL -> one row (0, 'store1', 95).
